summaries: A SEC Form 10-K Annual Report for BoxScore Brands, Inc. (later renamed American Battery Materials, Inc.) covering the fiscal year ended December 31, 2022. Relevant to the task, it reports the cash balance at the end of 2022 as $42,582, which serves as the beginning cash balance for the 2023 fiscal year. The document does not cover fiscal years 2023 or 2024, so while it provides the 2023 baseline figure required for the calculation, it lacks the 2023 year-end data needed to determine the beginning balance for 2024.

A Form 10-K Annual Report for American Battery Materials, Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023. Relevant to the task: The Consolidated Balance Sheets and Statements of Cash Flows provide cash balances as of December 31, 2022 ($42,582) and December 31, 2023 ($7,376). Since the ending balance of one fiscal year serves as the beginning balance of the next, these figures represent the beginning cash balances for 2023 and 2024, respectively. This document supplies the specific historical cash positions required to calculate the requested change in beginning balances between these periods.
